description: [DEPRECATED] Get MetaLend's recommended default rebalancer configuration for a given token symbol (e.g. 'USDC'): rebalancingManagerAddress plus recommended protocolIds/poolAddresses/domainIds. Intended for wallets with no existing config yet — for an existing wallet's current config use get_config instead. Rate limited to 20 calls/minute per caller, no more than one call every 3s.

token.description: Token symbol, e.g. USDC, USDT, MUSD, RLUSD, USDG, USDE, PYUSD.

name: get_default_config
title: Get default rebalancer config for a token
